allowed_uses: Finalist-level cross-check of displayed last price, daily range, volume and market-cap metadata.
Discovery of company/news context that must be re-confirmed by compiled-policy authority sources before affecting any gate.
Diagnostic comparison when an authoritative provider path is failing or inconsistent.
Human-readable corroboration links in research notes when clearly labeled nonauthoritative.
forbidden_uses: Strict G9 A/B/C/D PASS or live NBBO authority.
Price/DV20 PASS, market-cap primary/fallback PASS, history PASS, regime/breadth PASS, event confirmation, setup confirmation, R1/RR, R92/R93, candidate creation, or TRUE FULL GO.
Replacing missing authoritative data with public-page values.
Treating crawler/search timestamps, page render time or 'Son güncelleme' display text as an independent quote-event/trade-event timestamp.
High-volume per-symbol crawling across the full NASDAQ universe.
freshness_rule: Public Midas web pages may be cached/indexed and are not proven scheduler-grade live feeds. Any value without an independently verifiable authoritative timestamp is diagnostic only.
coverage_rule: No completeness claim. Use only on a bounded small set such as finalists/watch diagnostics; never use absence from Midas public pages as exclusion evidence.
market_data_findings: Midas public U.S.-stock pages expose displayed last price, open/daily range, volume, market cap and selected financial statement fields.
Official Midas pages state live U.S. market data is free inside the Midas customer experience, while public web/search surfaces can be delayed or cached.
Public stock pages do not establish consolidated National NBBO provenance or independent bid/ask/trade event timestamps.
